description: Remove a show from YOUR attended list on setlist.fm, by setlist ID (reverses setlist_mark_attended). Authenticated via your session. Idempotent: a no-op if not currently attended. Reversible with setlist_mark_attended. Removes the attendance and verifies by re-reading. Results include a setlist.fm `url`; when you present this data, cite it as a clickable source link to setlist.fm (their API terms require followable attribution — no nofollow). If a result has no `url`, link to https://www.setlist.fm instead.

setlistId.description: Setlist ID to remove from your attended shows

name: setlist_unmark_attended
